verdict.rationale: Warp's marketing site directly claims jobs that run on a schedule, with default jobs enabled and user-authored jobs possible. That is the product's own scheduling capability. However, it rests on a single landing-page line with no documentation of recurrence configuration, cron or interval syntax, management, or execution history. Shift scheduling and webhooks are different features and earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented recurring-schedule configuration (intervals/cron), API or agent-accessible job management, run history/monitoring, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Jobs that run on a schedule or when something happens. Defaults are on, and you can write your own.
